subject.title: fix(channels): keep healthy accounts running when credential files fail

question: Should this maintainer-labeled PR adopt account-scoped degraded startup for unavailable explicit credential files across the five affected legacy channel plugins after the release-note edit and real-run proof are completed?
rationale: The change intentionally alters startup failure handling and credential-resolution observability across several existing channel integrations, so a human should confirm the operational contract before landing.

options.title: Approve the isolated-degradation contract
options.body: Accept the shared typed diagnostic and Gateway isolation after removing the release-owned changelog entry and attaching redacted after-fix startup evidence.

options.title: Narrow the rollout
options.body: Limit the initial patch to the channel integrations with confirmed operator impact if maintainers do not want the common behavior adopted across all five paths.
